hypotheses.paper: HS^2, 'the set of geodesic rays into R^{1,2}' (l.584-585)
hypotheses.note: GX.HS 2 = GX.RaySphere (Causal.Minkowski 2), the unit sphere of the sup norm max(|t|, ||x||) (BBS-Q3). It is homeomorphic to (R^{1,2} minus 0)/R_{>0}, equivariantly: GX.raySphereHomeomorphRaySpace, GX.hs_homeomorph_raySpace_smul. The norm does not matter: GX.raySphereHomeomorph. HS^2 is homeomorphic to S^2: GX.hs2HomeomorphSph2.

hypotheses.paper: SO_0(1,2), 'the group of time-orientation preserving and orientation preserving isometries of R^{1,2}' (l.594-595)
hypotheses.note: Causal.Flat.lorentz 2: linear, minkQ-preserving, future cone into itself, det 1. This is the paper's own description and the linear part of DEC-152's Causal.Flat.isom 2. GX.HS.boostRot_eq_top: it is generated by the spatial rotations and the boosts along one axis. That it is the identity component of O(1,2) is not proved, because lorentz d has no topology at this pin (BBS-Q6).

hypotheses.paper: acts naturally (and projectively) on HS^2, preserving this decomposition (l.596)
hypotheses.note: GX.HS.smul_mem_piece_iff. The pieces are exactly the orbits: GX.HS.orbit_eq_piece, GX.HS.orbitEquiv, GX.HS.card_orbitRel_quotient (= 5). The action is projective in the chart {t = 1}: GX.HS.coe_smul_of_isFutureCausal.

gx's convention (DEC-16): ChartedSpace (HS 2) M and HasGroupoid M (gxGroupoid (Causal.Flat.lorentz 2) (HS 2)), read over the maximal atlas. The model is an analytical structure: GX.analyticStructure_hs2 (connected, locally connected, T2, faithful and rigid by homeomorphisms). It is also locally unloopable, locally path connected and semilocally simply connected.

GX.IsTopologicalSurface: Hausdorff and locally homeomorphic to R^2. No second countability and no connectedness. Given the HS-structure, the chart field holds automatically, so only T2 remains: GX.isHSSurface_iff. See questions.

findings: colI_v1.tex:603-605 (prose between labels, not this row): the hyperbolic clause swaps its counts. It reads 'g is hyperbolic if and only it admits exactly 6 fixed points: a pair of opposite points in dH^2_+-, and 2 pairs of opposite points in dS^2'. A hyperbolic element fixes TWO opposite pairs in dH^2_+- (the rays of its two null eigenlines) and ONE opposite pair in dS^2 (the rays of its spacelike eigenline). The total of 6 is right, and the 'In particular' sentence of l.607 is unaffected. Lean, for the standard boost B_zeta, zeta != 0 (hyperbolic by Causal.Flat.stdBoost_isHyperbolic): GX.HS.boost_fixed_deSitter_ncard gives exactly 2 fixed points in dS^2. GX.HS.boost_fixed_deSitter_iff says they are +-(0, e_1). GX.HS.boost_fixed_bdPlus_iff gives exactly (1, +-e_0) in dH^2_+, and their antipodes in dH^2_- follow by GX.hs_smul_neg. Only the standard boost is computed. Every hyperbolic element is conjugate to one (classical, not formalized).
colI_v1.tex:594: 'the group of of time-orientation preserving' has a duplicated 'of'.
questions: colI_v1.tex:616, 'a topological surface': is second countability (or paracompactness) part of it, and is the surface assumed connected? Reading taken: neither. GX.IsTopologicalSurface asks only Hausdorff and locally homeomorphic to R^2. This is the most inclusive reading, so a theorem proved for every HS-surface also holds under the narrower readings. If second countability is meant, add one field to GX.IsTopologicalSurface; nothing else in the module changes. The row stays partial and unmarked until this is ruled.

kb_proposals: HS^d is GX.HS d = RaySphere (Causal.Minkowski d), acted on by Causal.Flat.lorentz d (GXScaffold.BBS.HSModel). The sup norm of Minkowski makes H^d_+ literally the Klein disc {t = 1, ||x|| < 1} (GX.HS.mem_hypPlus_iff) and dH^d_+ exactly nullVec's image, with lean-causal's lorentzSphere action (GX.HS.smul_nullPt). On future causal rays the action is v -> Av/(Av)_0.

Rigidity of a normalised linear action on S(V): GX.eq_smul_of_eventually_eigen says that if the eigenvectors fill a neighbourhood of some v0 != 0, the map is a scalar (compare v0 + s w with v0 + 2 s w). Feed it GX.eventually_eigen_of_eqOn. If a preserved form takes a nonzero value, the scalar is 1. Without such a form, GL(V) is not faithful (GX.lem_analytique_counterexample).

Transitivity of SO_0(1,d) on the pieces of HS^d, d >= 2: use GX.HS.rot R (a spatial SpecialOrth lift; its membership goes through Causal.Flat.mem_lorentz_of, whereas unfolding the lorentz carrier times out) and GX.HS.boost (stdBoost), with the rapidity Real.artanh and GX.HS.sinh_artanh_eq. A base point reaches sigma by rot R * boost zeta. GX.HS.boostRot_eq_top is the Cartan decomposition.

A BBS-layer module outside GX/{BTZ,Lorentz}/ may not import Causal.* (scripts/causal_import_gate.py). It gets Causal.Flat.{Form,Isometries,Penrose} through `import GX.Lorentz.Bridge` and qualifies every Causal name.

Pitfall: for sigma : RaySphere V, `rw [<- abs_one]` (any rewrite that abstracts the literal 1) fails with 'motive is not type correct', because the 1 of `sphere 0 1` is in sigma's type. Rewrite in a hypothesis instead (`rwa [abs_one] at h`).
Pitfall: in the state-first phase, writing `<x, by sorry -- SORRY(label): to prove>` on one line comments out the closing bracket. Put the bracket on the next line.

A ChartedSpace over a space homeomorphic to a charted one: `letI := h.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.singletonChartedSpace (by simp); ChartedSpace.comp H X M` (GX.hs2ChartedSpace). The proof of GX.isLocallyUnloopable_raySphere then goes through verbatim (GX.isLocallyUnloopable_hs2).
notes: Imports: GX.Lorentz.Bridge, GX.Spherical.TroyanovTwoPi and Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Artanh only. It passes causal_import_gate (DEC-33). `lake build GXScaffold.BBS.HSModel` rebuilt this module only (8626/8626). It also typechecks with -DwarningAsError=true, with no warning. Global instances: GX.hsAction (MulAction (lorentz d) (HS d)), ContinuousConstSMul, GX.isAnalyticAction_hs, Nonempty (HS d), GX.hs2ChartedSpace (ChartedSpace R^2 (HS 2)), GX.locPathConnectedSpace_hs2, GX.isHSSurface_hs2, GX.IsHSSurface.opens. The GL(V) normalised action GX.linRaySmul is a def, not an instance, so it forms no diamond with GX.specialOrthAction or Affine's raySphereAction. The scaffold root scaffold/GXScaffold.lean does not import the new module (it is outside my dispatch): add `import GXScaffold.BBS.HSModel` there, or the axiom sweep never sees it (lean-causal kb/0025). Everything except transitivity holds for every d, and connectedness for d >= 1. Transitivity and the orbit count need d >= 2: for d = 1, dS^1 has two components. Not done, and outside this target's n = 2 scope: the point-links S(V/Rv) and pointwise stabilisers of the L2 table; the Klein metrics; SO_0(1,2) = PSL(2,R); the general classification of elements by fixed points; the invariant orientation of l.621; the suspension e(Sigma); and 'every HS-structure on S^2 is HS^2' (l.658, BBS-Q4). The fixed-point finding is about prose that carries no label. It is reported for the author and does not bear on this row.
